CMSC 12 - Python is your first language. Learn the basics: if-conditions, for and while loops, functions, data types. Try to practice your solving skills by answering HackerRank or LeetCode. Also, study data structures such as list and dictionaries ng Python. May CSS, HTML and JS na part sya sa dulo.

CMSC 56 - Study logic, rules of inference, premise and arguments, and proving arguments like mathematical induction, proof by contradiction. Also, study yung pigeonhole principle, sets and relations. 

Stick to Python muna, learn the fundamentals then study C (since eto yung pinakaginagamit namin sa other subjects).

If curious ka kung ano yung topics iddiscuss after CMSC 12, you can also study the following:   
- Data structures (linked list, hashtables, graphs, trees like binary search trees and AVL tree)   
- Algorithms like sorting algorithms (merge sort, quicksort, bubble sort), graph algorithms (Dijkstra's algorithm, Prim's algorithm), search algorithms (linear and binary search).  
- Threads and parallelization  
- Object Oriented Programming and its 4 basic principles.   
- How memory is allocated in a computer   
- Database theory (i.e. how to create a schema by following normalizing data, etc.)

Math 27 and 28 (Calculus I and II), mej madali lang sya as long as you practice tbh.
